protocol.seasonality: pooled 2023 monthly sums, frozen before January 2024
protocol.adaptive: previous observed month times known seasonal ratio
protocol.frozen: December 2023 anchor for January-June; June 2024 anchor for July-December
protocol.score_state: reset at start of each six-month window
protocol.minimum_threshold: log(1.05), fixed exploratory floor for all methods
protocol.scope: whole panel, three largest eligible regions, 25% municipalities with three fixed seeds
protocol.limits: reused archive; full-panel eligibility is retrospective; no real change labels or false-alarm guarantees
